sources.entry: learn-faster-kit by Hugo Lau - A creative educational framework for Claude Code, inspired by the "FASTER" approach to self-teaching. Ships with a variety of agents, slash commands, and tools that enable Claude Code to help you progress at your own pace, employing well-established pedagogical techniques like active learning and spaced repetition.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code (and Codex) learning-coach framework that builds personalized syllabi, runs spaced-repetition reviews, and guides active practice using the FASTER self-teaching method.
summary.what_it_does: Installs a set of slash commands (/learn, /review, /progress), a practice-creator agent, and shared Python scripts into a project directory to turn Claude Code into a learning coach. The /learn command generates a personalized syllabus for a topic and guides a session. Spaced repetition scheduling via a review scheduler script sets review intervals for topics already studied. Progress logging and a progress report track what has been learned. Users pick one of four modes (Balanced, Exam-Prep, Theory-Focused, Practical) that shapes syllabi and exercises. The coach uses teach-back prompts, asking the learner to explain concepts in their own words, as a core technique. The README also describes basic Codex support through AGENTS.md, with limits noted below.
use_cases: Learning a new programming language step by step
Preparing for a technical certification or exam
Getting up to speed with a framework or library
Onboarding to an unfamiliar codebase or technology
Reviewing previously learned topics on a spaced schedule
how_to_run: uv tool install learn-faster --from git+ (persistent install; URL truncated in README)
uvx --from git+ learn-faster (one-time run without installing; URL truncated in README)
notable: Four learning modes: Balanced, Exam-Prep, Theory-Focused, and Practical
Teach-back interaction that prompts the learner to explain concepts in their own words
Spaced repetition scheduler that sets review intervals
Installs project-local slash commands, agent definition, and Python helper scripts under .learning/ and .claude/
Codex support via AGENTS.md, with reduced coaching enforcement
caveats: Requires Python 3.12+, Claude Code, and the uv package manager
Codex support is weaker: no system-prompt replacement flag, and guided-choice prompts only work in Plan mode
Install commands in the README are partially truncated (URLs missing), so exact install source must be checked on GitHub
